user_intent: Build a custom cursor-label system that trails the pointer with per-hero-variant instruction text (e.g. "Drag and edit shapes"), styled with the site's design tokens, dismissed after the visitor interacts, and remembered across visits.
resolution: Final approach keeps the native cursor and trails a small Geist Mono caption pill (global controller in src/scripts/cursor-label.ts + cursor-label.css) offset 12px from the pointer, with per-variant copy defined in heroVariants.ts and motion-library scale in/out animation. Labels dismiss on first meaningful interaction with each scene (reusing the idle-nudge interaction listeners) and dismissals persist per variant in localStorage under cursor-label:seen, chosen over a database after discussing scale/performance. Styling was iterated entirely through global typography tokens (caption style moved to Geist Mono, 10px, 0.15em letter-spacing, 1.5 line-height) with fixed 8rem max-width and text-wrap balance to stop width-flash on reload.
